source_doc: Implementation Guide – Feed Personalization for Placements

entities.name: Feed Personalization for Placements
entities.description: Capability that lets brands tailor the feed experience per user by passing context signals during placement initialization.

entities.name: Genuin Placement
entities.description: Embeddable feed surface that brands initialize on their pages and configure with personalization parameters.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Client-side JavaScript SDK (gen_sdk.min.js) that renders Genuin placements and accepts data-* attributes for personalization.

entities.name: Placement v2 API
entities.description: Server API for fetching a personalized placement feed; accepts identity, context, filtering, configuration, and pagination parameters.

entities.name: Embed Configuration
entities.description: Set of HTML data-* attributes on the gen-sdk div used to pass personalization parameters to a placement.

entities.name: Style ID Parameter
entities.description: Required parameter identifying the style applied to a placement feed.

entities.name: Placement ID Parameter
entities.description: Required identifier of the placement being implemented.

entities.name: Device ID Parameter
entities.description: Required device identifier used for feed recommendation.

entities.name: Geo Parameter
entities.description: Optional object with lat, long, and radius_limit (KM) used to filter feed content by location.

entities.name: Place Parameter
entities.description: Optional object with country (ALPHA-3), state, city, and zipcode for hyper-local feed targeting.

entities.name: Time Parameter
entities.description: Optional timestamp (ISO 8601) used to show feed content relevant to a specific time.

entities.name: User Segmentation Parameter
entities.description: Optional object describing age, gender, age range, segment cohorts, race, and interests for audience-tailored feed.

entities.name: PDP URL Parameter
entities.description: Optional current page URL used to personalize feed against a specific product detail page.

entities.name: User Context Parameter
entities.description: Optional free-form contextual string for deeper personalization (e.g., 'Smart phone').

entities.name: Brand ID Parameter
entities.description: Optional array of brand identifiers restricting feed content to specific brands.

entities.name: Community IDs Parameter
entities.description: Optional list of UUIDs restricting content to specific communities or group hubs.

entities.name: Group IDs Parameter
entities.description: Optional list of UUIDs restricting content to specific thematic loops or content series.

entities.name: User Interests Parameter
entities.description: Optional array of interest topics used to bias the feed toward a user's stated interests.

entities.name: Posted By User Parameter
entities.description: Optional list of user UUIDs that filter the feed to only include posts from those creators.

entities.name: Previous Page Context Parameter
entities.description: Optional context string describing the page the user navigated from.

entities.name: Page Context Parameter
entities.description: Optional context string describing the user's current page.

entities.name: Brand Context Parameter
entities.description: Optional array of objects (id + relationship type such as 'podcast' or 'station') used to inject brand relationship context.

entities.name: Video Mark Complete Parameter
entities.description: Optional list of video/content UUIDs already finished by the user, used to dedupe or improve recommendation freshness.

entities.name: UI Style Overrides Configuration
entities.description: Optional object enabling dynamic feed appearance overrides including style_title, style_subtitle, and per-section title, subtitle, description, cover_url, and thumbnail_url.

entities.name: Section Title Macro
entities.description: Mandatory macro inside the configuration.sections array; the backend errors with code 6600 if missing.

entities.name: Pagination Parameters
entities.description: Set of pagination fields (page_session, last_video_id, section_id) required when paginating through a placement feed.

entities.name: Error Code 6600
entities.description: Backend error code returned when the sections array or a section title is missing from the macros payload.

entities.name: IP2DB11
entities.description: Geo database used to validate supported state and city names for the place parameter.

entities.name: OpenSearch
entities.description: Search backend currently powering placement feed lookups; doing simple search so some macro combinations may return empty results.

entities.name: ISO 8601
entities.description: Timestamp format required for the time parameter on the Placement v2 API.

entities.name: Shrushti Shah
entities.description: Stakeholder whose discussion drove the decision that section title is a mandatory macro field.

relationships.description: Feed personalization is implemented within Genuin placements.
The Genuin SDK renders and powers placements on the client.
Placements call the Placement v2 API to fetch personalized feed content.
The SDK reads embed configuration via data-* attributes to personalize the feed.
style_id is part of the embed configuration.
geo is part of the embed configuration.
place is part of the embed configuration.
time is part of the embed configuration.
user_segments is part of the embed configuration.
url is part of the embed configuration.
user_context is part of the embed configuration.
brand_id/brands_ids are part of the embed configuration.
community_ids is part of the embed configuration.
group_ids/loop_ids are part of the embed configuration.
user_interests is part of the embed configuration.
posted_by_user_ids is part of the embed configuration.
previous_page_context is part of the embed configuration.
page_context is part of the embed configuration.
placement_id is a required request body parameter.
style_id is a required request body parameter.
device_id is a required request body parameter.
page_context is an optional request body parameter.
previous_page_context is an optional request body parameter.
url is an optional request body parameter.
geo is an optional request body parameter.
place is an optional request body parameter.
user_context is an optional request body parameter.
user_segments is an optional request body parameter.
time is an optional request body parameter.
posted_by_user_ids filters feed content by creator UUIDs.
community_ids restricts content to specific communities.
loop_ids restricts content to thematic loops.
brands_ids restricts content to specific brands.
brand_context lets clients inject brand relationship context.
video_mark_complete dedupes seen content from recommendations.
configuration lets clients override feed UI styling dynamically.
page_session, last_video_id, and section_id are required for pagination.
Section title is a mandatory macro inside the configuration.sections array.
Missing or empty section title in the macros payload triggers error code 6600.
The time parameter must be supplied in ISO 8601 format.
Only state and city names supported by IP2DB11 are accepted in the place parameter.
The placement feed currently relies on simple OpenSearch queries, which can yield empty results for some macro combinations.
Discussion with Shrushti Shah established that section title is a mandatory macro field.
Seniority tier OTHER (role not specified in document).
